apiMessages.content: Plan my training between now and the trip. Schedule the sessions.

content.text:
**Taper plan: 2 weeks out, arrive fresh Aug 17.**

Week 1 (this week) = last real loading. Week 2 = sharp taper — short, low-volume touches only, full rest days dominate, nothing after Sat Aug 15.

- Tue Aug 4 — Limit Bouldering (keep, last hard limit session)
- Thu Aug 6 — Hangboard + Core (keep, last hard finger load)
- **Sat Aug 8 — Volume Climbing/Mileage (new)** — moderate grades, no limit attempts
- Sun Aug 9 — rest
- Mon–Mon Aug 10 — rest
- **Tue Aug 11 — Power Sharpening (new)** — short, low-volume hangboard + skill moves
- Wed Aug 12 — rest
- **Thu Aug 13 — Skin & Movement (new)** — easy, technique + forearm/finger care
- Fri Aug 14 — rest
- **Sat Aug 15 — Easy Activation (new)** — 30min, very light, opens skin without fatigue
- Sun Aug 16 — rest / travel
- Mon Aug 17 — trip start, fresh

Creating the four new sessions now.

input.title: Volume Climbing — Mileage
input.description: Last big-volume day before taper. Endurance/mileage focus, no limit attempts — keep it well below max effort.

exercises.name: Project / Push
exercises.notes: moderate grades only, mileage not limit — stop well short of failure

input.title: Power Sharpening
input.description: Short, high-quality touch. ~50% normal hangboard volume — maintain sharpness, add zero fatigue.

exercises.name: Hangboard Main Block
exercises.notes: ~50% normal volume, quality over quantity, stop immediately if any tweak

exercises.name: Skill Work
exercises.notes: few crux-style moves at low volume

input.title: Skin & Movement
input.description: Light technique day + finger/forearm care. Easy effort only.

input.title: Easy Activation
input.description: Last session before trip. Just enough to open skin/tendons — nothing that costs recovery.

exercises.name: Easy Traversing
exercises.notes: light, short, stop early — no fatigue

**Wk2 (taper):** Tue sharpening (short/light), Thu skin+movement (easy), Sat activation (30min trivial) — then rest Sun/Mon, fly in fresh.
